title: Very Smoky Slovakian Fish Pilaf
description: A hearty, smoky, and citrusy slovakian dish featuring fried fish, perfect for a sick day. Pair it with a side of rye bread for an authentic experience.
instructions: Rinse the fish fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the fish with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the fish to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the citrus juice to the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the rice mixture to a cedar-plank or a serving dish.
Place the cooked fish on top of the rice mixture.
